_comment: Frame 5 only. Kept separate from the hero manifest because upload-product-images.mjs has no idempotency check — re-running a manifest uploads the images again rather than reconciling. One manifest per upload batch. Product-level, not variant-attached: the review proof is true of both scents.

images.alt: 4.84 out of 5 stars from 135 customer reviews of the Body Lotion and Body Cream included in the 90-Day Coconut Reset.
